column1: The Housing Market from 2000 to 2014  The ﬁrst decade of the twenty -
ﬁrst century began with a boom in the housing market, followed by a
bust. Panel (a) shows an index of housing prices. Panel (b) shows housing
starts—the number of new houses on which builders began construction.
Data from: House prices are the seasonally adjusted prices from the S&P/Case–Shiller
20-City Composite Home Price Index, adjusted for inﬂation using the GDP deﬂator.
Housing starts are from the U.S. Department of Commerce.FIGURE 17-7
